title: Vibrantix Test Case
description: One entry in a data/modules/<slug>/<category>.json test case array.

id.description: Stable unique ID. Convention: <MODULE-PREFIX>-<CATEGORY-CODE>-<3-digit sequence>, e.g. EVID-E2E-001. Never renumber/reuse an existing ID once published — deprecate instead.

module.description: Module slug, must match the containing folder name in data/modules/ and the slug in data/manifest.json.

category.description: Must match the containing filename (without .json) and be one of manifest.json's categories list.

subFeature.description: Optional finer-grained grouping within the module, e.g. 'Evidence Upload', 'Review Workflow'.

title.description: Short imperative summary of what is being verified.

description.description: Optional longer explanation of intent/context, especially the WHY if non-obvious.

type.description: Execution mode this test case is written for.

automationStatus.description: Real-world automation state, independent of 'type' (a case can be designed for automation but not yet automated).

automationRef.description: Optional pointer to the automated spec, e.g. 'test-framework/tests/e2e/evidence-management.spec.ts:42'.

preconditions.description: State that must exist before step 1 (roles, seed data, flags).

testData.description: Optional concrete input values/payloads used by the steps.

tags.description: Free-form labels for cross-cutting filtering, e.g. 'rbac', 'multi-tenant', 'idor', 'iso27001'.

requirement.description: Optional traceability reference, e.g. 'ISO 27001 Annex A.8.15' or a user story ID.

linkedDefect.description: Optional QA tracker defect ID this case guards against regressing, e.g. 'EV-014'.

owner.description: Team or role responsible for maintaining this case, e.g. 'SDET', 'QA', 'Security'.

status.description: deprecated cases are kept for history but excluded from default views/exports.

execution.description: Latest execution outcome, set from the viewer's Mark Pass/Fail/Blocked controls (or edited by hand). Tracks the most recent run only, not history. Distinct from 'status' (lifecycle: active/draft/deprecated) and 'automationStatus' (whether an automated spec exists for this case).
